disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码（src/、scripts/、tests/）与配置文件，检查凭据文件路径（.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws）与密钥模式（API Key、TOKEN、私钥、助记词、钱包），零命中；源码中出现的 token 字样均为上下文计量的术语（token 单价、token 总数），与密钥无关。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code (src/, scripts/, tests/) and configuration files; checked credential file paths (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws) and secret patterns (API Key, TOKEN, private key, mnemonic, wallet) — zero hits; the token occurrences in source code are all terminology for context metering (token unit price, token total), unrelated to secrets.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主与客户端两侧是否存在凭据枚举或云账号探测行为（遍历密钥文件、查询云身份等），未发现；发布辅助脚本（publish.sh）中对 npm 令牌的环境变量引用仅为作者本机发布流程的占位，不随插件发布。
checked_items.en: Checked both host and client sides for credential enumeration or cloud account probing behavior (iterating key files, querying cloud identity, etc.) — not found; the environment variable reference to an npm token in the release helper script (publish.sh) is only a placeholder for the author's local release flow and is not shipped with the plugin.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件或遍历密钥的代码，也未发现读取敏感信息后外发的链路；唯一网络请求是向 npm 官方仓库查询本插件版本号（src/client/latestVersion.ts），用于插件信息卡片显示升级提示，不含任何敏感数据。
evidence.en: No code that reads credential files or iterates keys was found, nor any chain that reads sensitive information and then exfiltrates it; the only network request queries the npm official registry for this plugin's version (src/client/latestVersion.ts), used to display an upgrade hint on the plugin info card, and contains no sensitive data.

checked_items.zh: 插件不注册任何供模型调用的工具，不向系统提示注入片段；唯一面向用户的 /context 斜杠命令为纯客户端交互（打开上下文弹窗），候选文案是普通功能说明（「查看当前上下文构成，浏览各步骤组成」），不含系统指令或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not register any tools for model invocation, nor does it inject snippets into system prompts; the only user-facing /context slash command is pure client-side interaction (opening a context popup), and the candidate copy is ordinary feature description ("view current context composition, browse each step's contents"), containing no system instructions or wording that induces reading credentials.

checked_items.zh: 通读了开发指引（AGENTS.md）、说明文档（README.md），检查「忽略指令」「伪装系统消息」「远程拉取指令」「隐藏文本」等注入模式，零命中；AGENTS.md 为正常开发说明。另确认插件未提供压缩引擎或附件存储实现，不存在相关上下文篡改面。
checked_items.en: Read through the development guide (AGENTS.md) and documentation (README.md); checked for injection patterns such as "ignore instructions", "disguised system message", "remote instruction fetch", "hidden text" — zero hits; AGENTS.md is normal development documentation. Also confirmed the plugin provides no compression engine or attachment storage implementation, so no related context tampering surface exists.

evidence.zh: 插件无模型可见工具、无系统提示注入；/context 命令文案为普通功能说明（src/client/i18n.ts），不含注入措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-visible tools and no system prompt injection; the /context command copy is ordinary feature description (src/client/i18n.ts), containing no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何工具描述或文档诱导执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限；仓库文档为正常开发/使用说明。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions or documentation were found that induce executing install commands, rewriting configuration, or granting permissions; the repository documentation is normal development/usage instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在改写或注入模型输入消息的入口。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to the agent/pre-step event, so there is no entry point for rewriting or injecting model input messages.

checked_items.zh: 发布代码中未发现动态执行调用（eval、动态构造、子进程执行）；相关模式仅出现在开发辅助脚本（bundle-smoke.mjs）中，用于在测试环境以浏览器方式运行打包产物，且该脚本不在发布文件清单内。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution calls (eval, dynamic construction, subprocess execution) were found in the released code; the relevant patterns appear only in the development helper script (bundle-smoke.mjs), which runs the bundled output in a test environment via a browser, and that script is not in the release file manifest.

checked_items.zh: package.json 无安装钩子；补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明自身条目，不含可执行 JS 表达式；未发现混淆或动态解码执行模式。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install hook; the patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only a single-line insert declaring its own entry, with no executable JS expressions; no obfuscation or dynamic decode/execute patterns were found.

checked_items.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包（dsh.client），专项检查全部键盘监听：contextModal.tsx 与 images.tsx 中的监听均只响应 Escape 键关闭弹窗/图片灯箱，不记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或异常外联。
checked_items.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (dsh.client); a targeted check of all keyboard listeners: the listeners in contextModal.tsx and images.tsx only respond to the Escape key to close the popup/image lightbox and do not record key presses; no clipboard reading, credential RPC calls, or anomalous outbound connections were found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明，无可执行 JS 表达式（!!js 标量）；仓库中无其他 !!js 出现。
evidence.en: The patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only a single-line insert declaration, with no executable JS expressions (!!js scalars); no other !!js appears in the repository.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态执行工具（如 cordis_define / cordis_run）的任何调用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic execution tools (e.g., cordis_define / cordis_run) were found.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子，无 git 依赖（不存在未锁定提交的引用）；仓库 GitHub 工作流仅用于 PR 检查与作者发布 npm，运行在 GitHub 基础设施上、不随插件安装到用户环境，内容均为常规工程流程（安装、构建、测试、发布）。

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包（dsh.client），专项检查通过：两处键盘监听仅用于弹窗/灯箱的 Escape 关闭（contextModal.tsx:77、images.tsx:72），不记录按键，无剪贴板与凭据 RPC 行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (dsh.client); targeted check passed: the two keyboard listeners are used only for Escape-to-close of the popup/lightbox (contextModal.tsx:77, images.tsx:72), do not record key presses, and have no clipboard or credential RPC behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用注册外部子代理提供方的接口，不涉及轮次委派到进程外产品。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call interfaces for registering external sub-agent providers, and does not involve delegating turns to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 插件未使用 dsh 原生持驻机制（无后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标调用），未监听轮次终止事件。
evidence.en: The plugin does not use dsh's native persistence mechanisms (no background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goal invocations), and does not listen to turn termination events.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络请求目标：客户端仅有一个向 npm 官方仓库（registry.npmjs.org）查询本插件最新版本号的请求（src/client/latestVersion.ts），用于插件信息卡片显示升级提示，1 小时缓存、失败静默降级、不含任何敏感数据；源码中其他网址均为文档注释。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network request targets: the client has only one request to the npm official registry (registry.npmjs.org) to query this plugin's latest version (src/client/latestVersion.ts), used for an upgrade hint on the plugin info card, with a 1-hour cache, silent failure fallback, and no sensitive data; other URLs in the source are documentation comments.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感信息后外发的链路，未发现向未知或裸 IP 端点发起的连接、隧道或带外通道；客户端对会话历史的读取（src/client/historyPage.ts）走宿主标准接口、仅用于浏览器界面展示指定步骤内容。
checked_items.en: No chain that reads sensitive information and then exfiltrates it was found, nor any connections, tunnels, or out-of-band channels to unknown or bare IP endpoints; the client's read of session history (src/client/historyPage.ts) goes through the host's standard interface and is used only to display the specified step's content in the browser UI.

evidence.zh: 客户端唯一外联为向 npm 官方仓库查询本插件最新版本（src/client/latestVersion.ts:8,18,22），用于升级提示，不含敏感数据；未发现读取凭据后外发的链路，也未发现对未知端点的连接。
evidence.en: The client's only outbound connection is a query to the npm official registry for this plugin's latest version (src/client/latestVersion.ts:8,18,22), used for upgrade hints and containing no sensitive data; no chain that reads credentials and then exfiltrates, nor connections to unknown endpoints, were found.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在 LLM 路由运行时劫持面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, does not register a custom model adapter, and has no LLM routing runtime hijacking surface.

checked_items.en: Verified plugin identity: package name, repository, and author are consistent, with no signs of a same-name impersonation package; dependencies are all official and common public packages (@deepseek-ai/cordis, zod, react, etc.), with no git dependencies (no references to un-pinned commits), and no install-time execution hooks; the build dependency allowance (esbuild) in workspace configuration is part of the development repository configuration and is not shipped with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 补丁层仅插入自身条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未禁用任何安全行，未改写注入或拦截配置；未发现对审批类安全事件的优先监听。
checked_items.en: The patch layer only inserts its own entry, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable any security lines, and does not rewrite injection or interception configuration; no prioritized listening for approval-related security events was found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件（cordis.patch.yml）只插入自身条目，未覆盖或禁用沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch file (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts its own entry and does not override or disable security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，也不监听审批类安全事件，不存在截断审批链的优先监听。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and does not listen to approval-related security events, so there is no prioritized listener that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 对比上一版报告（0.33.1@02878dd6），本版本 manifest 声明（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client）与之前一致，未新增声明，无升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: Compared with the previous report (0.33.1@02878dd6), this version's manifest declarations (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client) are identical to before; no new declarations were added, and there is no risk of automatic activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未改写注入或拦截配置，未给安全插件追加服务导致永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch file does not rewrite injection or interception configuration, and does not append services to security plugins that could cause permanent waits.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动任何本地 Web 服务、不监听端口，运行时不引入额外的本机无认证接口面；动态沙箱未启用（本次未做动态验证），运行时结论基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start any local web service, does not listen on any port, and does not introduce an additional local unauthenticated interface at runtime; dynamic sandboxing was not enabled (no dynamic validation this time), so runtime conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.en: The plugin does not start a local web service, does not listen on any port, and does not add a local unauthenticated interface; this scenario targets plugins that start services, so it is not applicable to this plugin.

(1) DSH-X07/DG-R3-59：.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml 为 PR 检查 CI，运行于 GitHub 基础设施、不随插件安装执行，属常规工程实践，排除。

limits.en:
The plugin manifest (dsh field in package.json) does not explicitly declare capability fields; the capability declarations in this report are filled based on code measurement: network capability is true (a version check request to the npm official registry exists), and all other capabilities are false.

Dynamic sandboxing was not enabled (L4 = na), and no runtime validation was performed.

All 7 static pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one (rule IDs shown in each item):
(1) DSH-X07/DG-R3-59: .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml is a PR check CI, running on GitHub infrastructure and not executed during plugin installation; it is conventional engineering practice, so excluded.
(2) DSH-X07/DG-R3-59: .github/workflows/release.yml is a CI workflow for the author's npm release (OIDC trusted release), running on GitHub infrastructure and not executed during plugin installation; excluded.
(3) DSH-C05/DG-R4-53: the code style rule name object-curly-spacing at .oxlintrc.json:193 contains the substring curl, which was falsely matched by the exfiltration pattern; it is not network behavior, so excluded.
(4) DSH-X10/DG-R2-57: AGENTS.md is a development guide with normal coding standards, build/test, and release instructions, containing no injection wording; excluded.
(5) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55: scripts/bundle-smoke.mjs:58 uses dynamic construction to run the bundled output in a test environment; it is a development helper script and is not in the release file manifest (release only includes lib/client.js, lib/index.js, lib/index.d.ts, cordis.patch.yml, README.md, LICENSE); excluded.
(6) DSH-X05/DG-R3-57: the keyboard listener at src/client/components/contextModal.tsx:77 only closes the popup on Escape and does not record key presses; excluded.
(7) DSH-X05/DG-R3-57: the keyboard listener at src/client/components/images.tsx:72 only closes the image lightbox on Escape and does not record key presses; excluded.

Plugin compatibility is based on static compatibility layer code (compat.ts) and development documentation declarations, with no runtime validation performed.
